name: Triage: Feedo/Mooz watch · Cartsense/Nailah skip
what_it_does: Feedo: dish-photo → week of Instagram posts (claims IG→direct delivery share). Mooz: Bali F&B daily cross-platform posting beta. Cartsense: TikTok Shop ops for general ecom (not restaurants). Nailah: F&B AI OS with inventory, labor reports, demand forecast.
how_competitors_use_it: Content-only social automation (Feedo/Mooz) vs ecom Shop middleware (Cartsense) vs full ops OS (Nailah).
what_we_use_today: PlateAI/Flik already watched for content-only; Never86 closes shoppable sales.
gap: Feedo/Mooz → watch as content peers (no Shop close). Cartsense → skip (not restaurant vertical). Nailah → skip for Beyond the Hunt (labor/forecast drift); do not research their forecast features.
summary: Feedo/Mooz = content-only peers (watch light). Cartsense = skip (not restaurants). Nailah = skip Beyond the Hunt (labor/forecast).
